items.title: 518-million-year-old creature reveals the origins of spider fangs
items.summary: A tiny 518-million-year-old sea creature has revealed the earliest known evidence of the structures that eventually became spiders’ fangs. items.title: Stanford scientists discover immune cells that explode like microscopic bombs
items.summary: Stanford researchers discovered immune cells in flatworms that explode within minutes, killing nearby bacteria and foreign cells before vanishing completely. Their unusually fast and localized attack could offer clues for developing targeted treatments against infections and cancer.
